raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Keep the GLM-5.2 MI355X MXFP4 five-step MTP cookbook commands in sync with the InferenceX AgentX recipe and its latest validated SGLang ROCm daily image, [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#3851](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3851). The command builder still pinned `…-20260923` and the page text `…-20260930`, and the two MTP cells did not carry the recipe's prefill chunk size, static memory fraction or HiCache host pool size.

## Modifications

- `dockerImages["mi355x|mxfp4"]`: `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.20-rocm720-mi35x-20260923` → `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.21-rocm720-mi35x-20261008`. As in #41109, this pin is shared by every MI355X MXFP4 cell.
- MI355X MXFP4 **Low-Latency** (TP8/EP1): `--chunked-prefill-size 131072` → `32768`, `--mem-fraction-static 0.80` → `0.85`.
- MI355X MXFP4 **High-Throughput** (TP4/EP4 HiCache): add `--chunked-prefill-size 32768`, and replace `--hicache-ratio 1.0` with `--hicache-size 180` (a 180 GB host KV pool per rank). `write_through` stays the default write policy.
- `GLM-5.2.mdx`: update the AMD MTP note to the new image and these settings. Add a short source-reference comment in the config.
- The Balanced and `mtp-314` cells, other precisions and other hardware are otherwise unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

Documentation only; no code changes. This image and flag set were validated by [InferenceX run 38067578883](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/38067578883): all nine points (TP8/EP1 conc 1/2/4 and TP4/EP4 HiCache conc 4–16) passed, and GSM8K at TP4/EP4 conc 16 scored 0.9689 strict / 0.9719 flexible.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No new measurements. The values come from the InferenceX recipe and the run above.

## Validation

- Loaded `glm-5.2.jsx` with Node.js and compared it with `upstream/main`. Both versions have 52 cells. Only the two MI355X MXFP4 MTP cells change (the flags listed above), plus `dockerImages["mi355x|mxfp4"]`; every other field is identical.
- Preserved the file's existing line endings (it mixes CRLF and LF). `git -c core.whitespace=cr-at-eol diff --check` passes.
- Did not run the full Mintlify build (sparse docs checkout). No components, navigation or links change.

## Checklist

- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).

## AI model disclosure

Prepared with Claude Opus 5.5 via the Cursor agent at the author's request. No delegated models.

@@ -137,7 +137,7 @@ import { agentx } from "/src/snippets/agentx/zai-org/glm-5.2.jsx";
 **gfx950 block-FP8 accuracy: fixed as of the pinned MI355X image (`v0.5.13.post1-rocm720-mi35x-20260618`).** Earlier SGLang ROCm images miscompiled AMD aiter's `gemm_a8w8_blockscale_bpreshuffle` GEMM on gfx950 (ROCm 7.2): the error was small per layer but compounded across all 78 layers and silently corrupted output — in-context reasoning broke (GSM8K ≈ 0) while short factual prompts still looked fine. The root cause was a gfx950/ROCm-7.2 miscompile of the CK kernel (a packed illegal-type FMA that relied on an LLVM coercion pass removed in ROCm 7.2; non-deterministic wrong rows near tile boundaries). This is resolved in the pinned image and newer: GLM-5.2-FP8 on MI350X/MI355X (gfx950) was re-validated at TP4 and TP8 — **GSM8K ≈ 0.96 (0% invalid)** and **15/15 needle-in-haystack retrieval to ~118K tokens**. **MI300X / MI325X (gfx942) were never affected.** If you must run an older image, treat gfx950 FP8 output as unverified. Background: [sgl-project/sglang#28685](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/28685) (analysis) and the upstream CK fix [ROCm/rocm-libraries#8639](https://github.com/ROCm/rocm-libraries/pull/8639) (scalar FMA + accumulator anchor; restores correctness and determinism at -O3).
 </Note>
 
-- **MTP / EAGLE speculative decoding on AMD.** Five-step MTP is validated for `amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4` on MI355X with `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.20-rocm720-mi35x-20260930`. Choose **Low-Latency** for TP8/EP1, or **High-Throughput** for TP4/EP4 with HiCache (`--enable-hierarchical-cache --hicache-ratio 1.0`). HiCache uses the default `kernel`, `page_first`, and `write_through` settings. MTP remains unvalidated for GLM-5.2 on MI300X/MI325X and for the other MI355X checkpoint precisions.
+- **MTP / EAGLE speculative decoding on AMD.** Five-step MTP is validated for `amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4` on MI355X with `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.21-rocm720-mi35x-20261008`. Choose **Low-Latency** for TP8/EP1, or **High-Throughput** for TP4/EP4 with HiCache (`--enable-hierarchical-cache --hicache-size 180`, a 180 GB host KV pool per rank). Both use `--chunked-prefill-size 32768` and `--mem-fraction-static 0.85`. HiCache uses the default `kernel`, `page_first`, and `write_through` settings. MTP remains unvalidated for GLM-5.2 on MI300X/MI325X and for the other MI355X checkpoint precisions.
 
 ## 3. Advanced Usage
